description: Valtuutus provides a developer-focused, modern library for creating ReBAC without complexity.
releaseNotes:
## What's Changed

### Features
- **Add .NET 11 support with runtime-async** (#190) — Multi-targets . Enables  for  across all libraries and benchmarks.

### Performance
- **Dedicated single-entity attribute fetch with early exit** (#189) — New  on  returns  instead of . Breaks inner loop after first match per attribute name, eliminating the O(n) full-bucket scan. : 127 µs → 6.5 µs (~20x speedup), allocs 3983 B → 3467 B.
- **Reduce GC pressure in function check hot path** (#188) —  changed from heap-allocated  to , eliminating one allocation per lambda invocation. Remove intermediate  in  by indexing directly into args array. Pre-compute  at construction time on . Replace  in hot paths with . Gen0: 15.6 → 8.8 per 1000 ops (~44% reduction).
- **DataTable TVPs to SqlDataRecord** (#168) by @makeentosch — Replaces -based TVP construction with , reducing allocations in SqlServer write paths.

### Bug Fixes
- **Schema-keyed SQL cache and pure snap token resolution** (#185, #184) by @jafin — SQL query cache now keyed by schema so multi-schema deployments don't share cached queries across schemas. Snap token resolution made pure (no side effects). Covers both Postgres and SqlServer.
- **Qualify  type name with configured schema** (#182) by @jafin — SqlServer TVP type lookup now respects the configured DB schema instead of defaulting to .
- **Allow permission bodies to reference themselves and forward-declare other permissions** (#180) by @jafin — Lang parser now handles self-referential and forward-referenced permission bodies without error.
- **Don't cancel memoized tasks via short-circuit CTS in CheckEngine** (#177) — Fixes a race where the short-circuit  would cancel in-flight memoized tasks still needed by other branches.

### CI / Infrastructure
- Replace SonarCloud with independent coverage collection
- Coveralls integration with per-PR changed-file coverage
- Coverage collected on push to 
- Drop Cake build script — version and release notes now managed outside source
- Benchmark workflow fixes (base benchmarks, PR comment posting, concurrency cancellation)
- Bump  → 5.3.0,  → 21,  → 3

- @jafin made their first contribution in #180
